title: Envelope
description: Shared wire framing; each data role retains its own generated schema.

revision.description: Exact publication requested by the viewer.

data.description: Original complete projection, never an authority token.

Log.description: Bounded latest output, explicitly marked when earlier text was dropped.

job.description: Original preparation identity, independent of publication identity.

resource.description: Original resource; the viewer checks this as well as the job.

text.description: Literal host-normalized diagnostic tail, not source or evidence.

truncated.description: Some earlier output was not retained, including worker truncation.
